This guide explains everything about the CodeMirror 6 Editor plugin in simple terms. Think of it as a super-powered text editor that makes writing in TiddlyWiki way more fun and easier. ## What is this plugin? You know how when you write code or notes, it's nice when things are colorful and organized? That's what this plugin does! It replaces TiddlyWiki's basic text editor with a fancy one called "CodeMirror 6" that has tons of cool features. ## The Main Editor ### CodeMirror 6 Editor (The Core) This is the main plugin that everything else builds on. It gives you: * Syntax Highlighting - Different parts of your text get different colors, making it easier to read * Auto-completion - Start typing and it suggests what you might want to write (like autocomplete on your phone!) * Bracket Matching - When you click on a bracket `(` or `[`, it shows you where the matching one is * Auto-close Brackets - Type `(` and it automatically adds `)` for you * Multiple Cursors - Hold Ctrl and click to type in multiple places at once (super cool!) * Undo/Redo - Made a mistake? Ctrl+Z to undo, Ctrl+Y to redo * Search & Replace - Find text and replace it with something else ## Language Plugins These plugins teach the editor how to understand and colorize different programming languages. When you write code blocks, the editor will highlight the code beautifully! ### TiddlyWiki Mode The most important one! It understands TiddlyWiki's special syntax: * WikiLinks like `[[My Page]]` * Bold `''text''` and italic `//text//` * Headings, lists, tables * Widgets like `<$list>` and `<$button>` * Macros like `<>` * Filters like `[tag[example]]` * Typed blocks with syntax highlighting (`$$$.js`, `$$$.css`, etc.) ### Other Languages * C++ - Systems programming and game development * CSS - For styling (colors, fonts, layouts) * Go - Google's programming language for servers * HTML - For web page structure * Java - Enterprise and Android development * JavaScript - The programming language of the web * JSON - For data (like settings files) * LaTeX - For academic papers and math formulas * Lezer - Grammar definition language (for parser developers) * Markdown - Another way to format text * PHP - Server-side web programming * Python - A popular programming language * Rust - Safe systems programming * Sass/SCSS - CSS with superpowers (variables, nesting) * SQL - For database queries * WAST - WebAssembly Text format * XML - For structured data * YAML - For configuration files ## Theme Plugins Themes change how the editor looks - the colors, the style, everything! Pick one that's easy on your eyes or just looks cool. ### Available Themes Theme | What it looks like --- | --- Ayu | Clean and modern (Dark, Mirage, Light) Catppuccin | Soft pastel colors (Latte, Frappe, Macchiato, Mocha) Dracula | Purple vampire vibes (Dark, Light) Everforest | Calm green forest colors Flexoki | Warm and readable GitHub | Like GitHub's code view (Light, Dark, Dimmed) Gruvbox | Retro warm colors Kanagawa | Japanese ink painting inspired Material | Google's Material Design style Monokai | Classic programmer favorite Nord | Cool arctic blue colors One | Atom editor's popular theme Palenight | Elegant purple and blue Rose Pine | Soft and dreamy Solarized | Easy on the eyes, scientifically designed Tokyo Night | Neon city vibes Zenburn | Low contrast, relaxing -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Sidebar Slider [Plugin] — a Plugin for TiddlyWiki5 (https://burningtreec.github.io/tiddlywiki-sidebar-slider/) 【turn1search6】 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: 1.4 years ago; # Sidebar Slider [Plugin] a Plugin for TiddlyWiki5 ## About 27th May 2025 at 7:01pm About Plugin Sidebar Slider ### This plugin adds a thin vertical bar to your TiddlyWiki which can be dragged and which changes the width of the sidebar or the story river respectively ### There are more Features: * Showing the sidebar on the left * CSS unit conversion using integrated functions * Double-click on the sidebar slider closes the sidebar * A slider between the editor and the editor preview * There's a "Reset" button under "Themetweaks" in the $:/ControlPanel and a "Reset" keyboard shortcut `alt-S` ## Metrics 29th May 2025 at 4:54pm $:/tags/SideBar ### You can convert absolute metrics (and em) to `pixels` using the integrated function `<>` * 1em: 15px (see how this translates in the sidebar where 1em has a different value) * 1cm: 37.8px * 1mm: 3.78px * 1Q: 0.945px * 1in: 96px * 1pc: 16px * 1pt: 1.3333333333333333px ## Installation 24th May 2025 at 7:27am Installation Plugin Sidebar Slider ### The simplest way to install this plugin is to drag the following box to your Wiki, save your Wiki and reload # SidebarSlider: A sidebar slider  ## $:/plugins/BTC/SidebarSlider ## 0.0.16 ### Keep in mind that this plugin is in early alpha state and is going to be updated continuously, so keep checking for updates! ## Star me on GitHub! 24th May 2025 at 7:29am GitHub LikeyLikey Plugin This TiddlyWiki contains the following tiddlers: -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- My TiddlyWiki — a non-linear personal web notebook (https://tiddlywiki.com/prerelease/editions/full/) 【turn1search7】 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: 3 weeks ago;
